title: Ottawa Rosefellow Kanata fire-flow proposal and calculation set
code_edition: Unknown; attachments cite FUS 2020 and Ottawa water-distribution guidance, not a stated OBC edition
document_date: 2023-03-24 proposal letter and fire-flow assessment; portal files dated 2023-04-04 and 2023-06-02

facts.text: The proposal letter is addressed to Ottawa’s Planning, Real Estate and Economic Development Department and identifies project/reference 22081-Rosefellow Kanata / 2301-01A.
facts.locator: Proposal letter, PDF p. 1; portal URL includes site-plan file D07-12-22-0186

facts.text: The letter’s page 4 states a 10,000 L/min FUS total, while page 5 states 14,000 L/min and says it was reduced to 1,100 L/min; that same page says the proposed flow is 7,500 L/min and available City supply is over 11,000 L/min.
facts.locator: Proposal letter, PDF pp. 4-5; page 5 visually inspected

facts.text: A separate assessment carrying the same Rosefellow / 2301-01A identifiers lists a three-storey 248,581 sq ft (23,094 m²) Kanata Buildings gross floor area; it calculates 46,000 L/min base fire flow, 23,000 L/min after a 50% sprinkler reduction, and 17,000 L/min after the additional 25% Step I reduction.
The documents do not explain whether the letter and calculation sheet cover the same individual building or different buildings within the project.
facts.locator: Comparison of proposal letter PDF pp. 4-5 and assessment PDF pp. 1-3

limitations: The two files share project/reference identifiers but do not establish whether the calculation sheet and letter concern the same building.
The letter contains an internally inconsistent “1,100 L/min” statement and differing FUS values; do not infer the intended correction.
No OBC alternative-solution application, building permit decision, or architectural/fire-system drawings are included.
